The `Role` union is defined in `src/types/member.ts`. I searched the whole tree with `grep` and kept only files that import or annotate `Role`. Excluded: `corpus-manifest.json` and `scripts/manifest-parts/*`, which hold signature strings rather than code; `scripts/build-manifest.ts`, which only has a description string; and matches that are just the word "Role" in comments, UI labels, or template strings (`member-service.ts:36`, `member-service.test.ts:2`, `invitation-list.tsx:68`, `member-table.tsx:45`, `activity-service.ts:222`).

Files that name the type are the definition, its direct consumers in `src`, and the tests that import it. Two of the consumers hold `Role` in a `Record` key position: `src/lib/format.ts` (`ROLE_LABELS`) and `src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx` (`TONE_BY_ROLE`). `src/lib/permissions.ts` uses it as a `Record` value, and `src/server/db/seed.ts` uses it in an array type. `tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts` uses it as a `Record` key, so it will need updating too.

The `src/schemas/role.ts` file has a compile-time parity check, so a new role must also be added to its enum or the build will fail.

ANSWER: src/types/member.ts, src/types/feature-flag.ts, src/types/permission.ts, src/types/event.ts, src/app/(dashboard)/[orgSlug]/settings/members/page.tsx, src/server/db/seed.ts, src/emails/invite-email.tsx, src/server/repositories/member-repository.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/schemas/role.ts, src/components/domain/member/role-select.tsx, src/components/domain/member/invite-member-form.tsx, src/components/domain/permission/role-badge.tsx, src/components/domain/member/member-table.tsx, src/lib/format.ts, src/lib/permissions.ts, tests/contract/permissions.test.ts, tests/server/_support/fixtures.ts, tests/components/role-select.test.ts, tests/config/nav.test.ts, tests/lib/permissions.matrix.test.ts, tests/components/command-groups.test.ts
